newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise to buy out Elyo.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise to buy out Elyo.

text.p: French water and utilities company Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Friday it is making an offer to buy out the remaining 21.7 percent of its Elyo heating and energy subsidiary it does not hold.
Lyonnaise currently owns 6,531,408 Elyo shares, or 78.3 percent of the capital and 83.6 percent of the voting rights, Lyonnaise said in a statement.
It will make a public offer to buy all the 1,806,670 shares outstanding, representing 21.7 percent of the capital and 16.4 percent of voting rights.
Lyonnaise will get an independent valuation of Elyo shares by the underwriting bank and the offer terms will be sent to the stock market authorities in the latter half of December.
If Lyonnaise gets at least 95 percent of Elyo, it will follow up with a compulsory buy-out and withdrawal of shares.
The offer is aimed at simplifying the financial structure of the Lyonnaise group, while respecting the interests of minority shareholders, it said.
It is also part of the company's strategy to focus on core businesses and long-term development of the heating sector.
Elyo manages heating systems for municipalities and is a facilities manager.
